common.reasonHint: At least 3 characters, kept in the history
common.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB
common.receiptHint: A photo or PDF up to 10 MB

backPost.title: Post documents not yet in the books
backPost.body: Posts the invoices, credit notes and payments that have no journal yet and recognises the revenue months that are due. Running it again posts nothing twice.
backPost.nothing: Nothing was waiting to be posted

statements.title: Accounts and statements
statements.lede: Statements built from the journal of {building}; every figure comes from posted entries.
statements.emptyIncome: No entries in this period yet. Pick another year, or back-post to book the documents you already have.
statements.foot: Figures in brackets are negative · a dash (–) means no entries
statements.surplusNote: Fund contributions are equity and not part of income
statements.balanceFoot: The light ledger has no year-end closing, so the accumulated surplus runs to the date chosen.
statements.trialFoot: Balances are shown in each account's normal direction.

receivablesCheck.title: Receivables against the books
receivablesCheck.hint: The ledger's receivable account against what the bills still say is owed, as of {date}
receivablesCheck.differsHint: Some documents are not in the books yet. Back-post, then check again.

journals.title: Journal
journals.lede: Every posted entry, newest first. Entries cannot be edited; a correction is a reversal.

empty.title: No entries yet
empty.body: Entries appear by themselves when bills are issued, payments recorded and expenses paid. Back-post from the statements.

journals.panelReversed: This entry has been reversed; open the reversal below.
journals.panelReversible: Posted by hand and cannot be edited. If it is wrong, reverse it and post it again.
journals.panelDocument: Posted from a {source}. Correct the document; the books follow.
journals.immutable: Journal entries cannot be edited or deleted; corrections are reversals and new entries.

reverse.title: Reverse this entry
reverse.body: The mirror entry of “{memo}” will be posted; the original stays in the journal.
reverse.reasonHint: At least 3 characters, added to the reversal's description

journalForm.title: Post an adjustment
journalForm.lede: Opening balances, withholding tax remitted or a correction. It posts only when debits equal credits.
journalForm.forbidden: Only the office's owner, manager or accountant posts adjustments.

section.linesHint: Each line is a debit or a credit, at least two lines
section.memoHint: Say what this entry is; the auditor reads it here

journalForm.openingHint: Account balances on the day the office started on getproperty
journalForm.fundBankNote: Crediting this account needs a resolution
journalForm.resolutionHint: A line credits a fund's bank account; cite a resolution of this building
journalForm.noResolutions: This building has no adopted resolution yet
journalForm.errorTitle: Cannot post yet: {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}

lineError.both: Line {n}: enter a debit or a credit, not both

summary.title: Totals
summary.balanced: Debits equal credits, ready to post
summary.note: Totals add up the figures typed; the API checks again when posting.

blocked.lines: At least two lines are needed
blocked.unbalanced: Debits and credits still differ by {amount}

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.lede: The chart of the office's legal form. System accounts carry the posting rules; codes and types never change.
accounts.name: Account
accounts.addTitle: Add an account to the chart
accounts.addBody: The code must be unique; the type cannot change once the account has entries.
accounts.typeHint: Which statement the account belongs to
accounts.bankHint: For a bank account in the books; used to match bank statements
accounts.codeFixed: An account's code and type cannot change.
accounts.deactivateBody: Existing entries stay; new entries can no longer use this account.
accounts.activateBody: The account can be used in new entries again.

band.rule: {range} needs {count, plural, one {# approval} other {# approvals}} from {roles}
band.ruleDraft: Once sent: {range} needs {count, plural, one {# approval} other {# approvals}} from {roles}

block.requester: You drafted this request, so you cannot approve it; another approver in this band must decide.
block.decided: You have already decided; it waits for another approver.
block.role: Your role is not in this band.

expenses.title: Expenses and approvals
expenses.lede: Request, approve within the limits and record payment. Nobody approves their own request.

mine.title: Nothing waits for you
mine.body: Requests within your band that you have not decided appear here.

all.title: No expense requests yet
all.body: Start with a request and attach the vendor's quotation or invoice.

draft.title: No drafts
draft.body: Drafts not yet sent for approval appear here.

submitted.title: Nothing awaits approval
submitted.body: Requests sent and waiting for approvers appear here.

approved.title: Nothing to pay
approved.body: Fully approved requests waiting for payment appear here.

paid.title: Nothing paid yet
paid.body: Recording a payment posts it to the books and issues the WHT certificate.

expense.unverifiedBody: A rate used here still awaits a tax adviser's confirmation for juristic persons. Check it before paying.
expense.fundNote: From a fund, under a resolution
expense.foot: Totals, tax and the net amount are computed by the system when saved. Nobody approves their own request.

expenseAction.submitBody: {amount}. The system numbers it and notifies the approvers of its band; lines can no longer be edited.
expenseAction.rejectBody: One rejection ends this request; the requester starts a new one.
expenseAction.cancelBody: Only before payment. The request stays in the history.
expenseAction.reasonHint: At least 3 characters; the requester sees it

pay.title: Record payment of {number}
pay.fromHint: The bank account the money left
pay.cashNote: Cash needs no proof; attach the payee's receipt later if you have it.
pay.whtNote: The WHT certificate (50 ทวิ) is issued to the payee automatically.

attach.title: Attach a document
attach.body: A quotation, the vendor's invoice or a receipt

expenseForm.title: Request an expense
expenseForm.lede: Fill it in from the vendor's quotation or invoice. Save a draft, then send it for approval from the request.
expenseForm.notDraft: This request was sent for approval; only drafts can be edited.
expenseForm.noChartTitle: No expense account to choose yet
expenseForm.noChart: A request needs an expense account. Ask the accountant to add or reactivate one in the chart of accounts.

section.payeeHint: Pick a party in the system so a WHT certificate can be issued
section.linesHint: Amounts include VAT; withholding and the net amount are computed when saved
section.sourceHint: Paying from a fund needs a resolution of this building
section.filesHint: Quotation, vendor invoice or photos of the work
section.noteHint: Why it is needed, what the approvers should know

expenseForm.payeeHint: Search the parties in the system
expenseForm.noPayee: No party found; type the name below
expenseForm.payeeNameHint: For a payee outside the system (no 50 ทวิ can be issued)
expenseForm.unverifiedBody: Withholding rates for juristic persons still await a tax adviser's confirmation. They apply as set; check before paying.
expenseForm.taxIdTitle: The payee needs a tax id
expenseForm.taxIdBody: A line withholds tax, so a 50 ทวิ must be issued. Pick a party with a tax id, or add it to the party before recording the payment.
expenseForm.operatingHint: Paid from the office's operating account as usual
expenseForm.noFunds: This building has no fund yet
expenseForm.resolutionHint: An adopted resolution of this building
expenseForm.noResolutions: This building has no adopted resolution yet
expenseForm.errorTitle: Cannot save yet: {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}}

error.title: Give the request a title
error.vat: Line {n}: VAT cannot exceed the amount

summary.title: This request
summary.note: Approval limits from the settings; the band follows the total when sent.

certificates.title: Withholding tax certificates
certificates.lede: The 50 ทวิ issued when an expense with withholding was paid; numbers run without gaps.

empty.title: No certificates yet
empty.body: Recording payment of an expense with withholding issues its 50 ทวิ.

certificates.panelReady: Print it for the payee or send the PDF.
certificates.panelPending: The PDF is being built; refresh in a moment.
certificates.foot: The official wording is in the PDF the system builds.

expenseSettings.title: Approval limits and tax
expenseSettings.lede: Who approves expenses up to which amount, and the withholding rates. Every value is the office's setting; a change is a new version with a reason.
expenseSettings.bandsHint: A request's total decides how many approvals it needs and from which roles
expenseSettings.whtHint: Rates a request may use and the income type printed on the 50 ทวิ
expenseSettings.matchingHint: The date window used to find a statement line's match
expenseSettings.sinceTenant: Set by the office, in force since {date}
expenseSettings.sincePlatform: The system default, in force since {date}; set it to match your regulations or resolution
expenseSettings.missing: The API did not send this setting
expenseSettings.unverifiedBody: Rates marked “unconfirmed” are common rates not yet confirmed for condominium or housing-estate juristic persons. Mark them confirmed once your adviser has checked them.

bandsEditor.readOnly: Only the office's owner changes the limits.

error.order: Must be above the previous band
error.reason: Give a reason of at least 3 characters

whtEditor.verifiedHint: Switch on once you have it in writing
whtEditor.reasonHint: For example: the adviser confirmed the services rate
whtEditor.readOnly: Your role cannot change the tax rates.

error.label: Name it in both languages
error.reason: Give a reason of at least 3 characters

funds.title: Funds
funds.lede: Each fund's money in the bank and its equity (contributions billed less money used). Money out needs a resolution and another member's approval.
funds.waiting: Awaiting approval: {count, plural, one {# transfer} other {# transfers}}

empty.title: No funds yet
empty.body: A building's sinking fund is created with the first fund contribution billed, or create one here.

funds.panelBody: Move money in or out. Money out cites a resolution, and another member approves before it is posted.
funds.ledgerHint: Entries on the fund's bank and equity accounts, newest first

fundActions.newBody: Its bank and equity accounts are added to the chart.
fundActions.name: Fund name
fundActions.bankHint: Used for balances and bank matching

transfer.title: Request a transfer · {name}
transfer.body: The fund's bank account holds {balance} now
transfer.outHint: Moves money from the fund's account to the operating account, for use under a resolution.
transfer.inHint: Moves contributions received into the fund's account.
transfer.counterHint: The other side of the transfer
transfer.resolutionRequired: Money out cites an adopted resolution of this building
transfer.noResolutions: This building has no adopted resolution yet
transfer.noteHint: What it is for; the approver reads it
transfer.secondUser: Another member (owner, manager or committee) must approve this request before it is posted.
transfer.approveOut: Takes {amount} out of {fund}; it is posted at once.
transfer.approveIn: Moves {amount} into {fund}; it is posted at once.
transfer.rejectBody: The requester sees the reason; nothing is posted.

transferRecord.decideHint: Check the resolution and the amount, then decide.
transferRecord.waitOther: You asked for it, so you cannot approve it; another member decides.
transferRecord.waitApprover: Waiting for an owner, manager or committee member.
transferRecord.ruleOut: Fund money is used only under a resolution and approved by someone other than the requester; on approval the fund's equity drops by the amount taken out.
transferRecord.ruleIn: Money in also needs an approver other than the requester.

petty.title: Petty cash
petty.lede: Each building's petty cash float, its book balance, the custodian and the last count.

empty.title: No petty cash yet
empty.body: Set up a float for small spends, then top it up through expense requests.

petty.panelBody: Record spends with their receipt, count the cash now and then, top up through an expense request.
petty.noAccounts: There is no active expense account, so spends cannot be recorded. Ask the accountant to add one to the chart.
petty.countsHint: Cash counted against the book balance

pettyActions.newTitle: Set up a petty cash float
pettyActions.newBody: Its ledger account is created; money comes in through petty cash top-up requests.
pettyActions.name: Float name
pettyActions.custodianHint: Who keeps the cash and records spends
pettyActions.spendBody: Book balance {balance}; a spend cannot exceed it.
pettyActions.countBody: Book balance {balance}. Enter the cash actually counted; the difference is posted for you.
pettyActions.topUpBody: Float {float}, balance {balance}. This becomes an expense request approved within the limits.
pettyActions.topUpHint: Usually what was spent since the last top-up

bank.title: Bank reconciliation
bank.lede: Import the bank's statement, then match its lines to payments received, expenses paid and fund transfers.

empty.title: No statements imported yet
empty.body: Download the CSV from your bank and import it here; clear matches are made for you.
empty.noBank: Add the office's bank account in settings first.

bankImport.title: Import a bank statement
bankImport.body: Importing the same file again adds nothing; lines an earlier file already brought are skipped.
bankImport.formatHint: The bank that produced the file
bankImport.tooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB
bankImport.replayed: This file was imported before; nothing new

bankQueue.title: {bank} {account}
bankQueue.noCandidates: No entry of the same amount in the date window. If it needs no match, ignore it with a reason.
bankQueue.days: {count, plural, one {# day apart} other {# days apart}}
bankQueue.matchBody: {amount} with “{label}”. Matching does not change the payment or the expense.
bankQueue.ignoreBody: “{description}” leaves the queue; give a reason for the auditor.
bankQueue.ignoreHint: Bank fees, interest, or lines that need no match
bankQueue.unmatchTitle: Put the line back in the queue
bankQueue.unmatchBody: The line waits to be matched again.

unmatched.title: Nothing left to match
unmatched.body: Every line of this file is matched or ignored.

ignored.title: Nothing ignored
ignored.body: Lines ignored with a reason appear here.

budgetExpense.title: Budget vs actual expenses
budgetExpense.hint: Expenses in the books during the budget period, as of {date}
budgetExpense.note: Actuals come from the building's journal entries in the budget period; a line without an account has no actual.
